name: Pause Downloads While Playing
author: tago
description: Pauses game downloads while you play, and resumes them when you stop.
details: Downloading in the background can cause lag in online games and stutter while the disk is busy. When a game started from Ascendara launches, running downloads are paused. They resume when the last running game closes. Downloads you paused yourself are left alone.
affects: Pauses and resumes your game downloads around play sessions

settings.label: Resume downloads when the game closes
